semantic.justification: Represented native RTF import now carries current-model character decoration, links and paragraph indentation; complete upstream responsibilities remain unverified. RTF byte decoding now selects pinned SAL ASCII, ISO-8859 and KOI8 aggregates. UTF-8 code page 65001 now dispatches to the pinned SAL converter with its native malformed-input and BOM defaults. Uses OStringToOUString default flags and FLUSH, retaining private-use undefined-byte mapping and incomplete UTF-8 replacement.
